newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade dull.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade dull.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in dull trading on Thursday as players stayed sidelined due to the year-end, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from last Tuesday's closing. No deals were heard in crude palm oil, last done at 1,216 rupiah/kg.
"There was not much happening today because of year-end factors," one trader said. "The market will continue being thinly traded until next week."

Data from Belawan Port showed that MT Menado will leave the North Sumatran Port on Friday for India with 5,500 tonnes of crude palm oil. The MT Vladimir Vysotski will also leave on Friday for Argentina with 6,870 tonnes of palm kernel oil.

The MT Japfa Dua will leave today for Jakarta with 1,000 tonnes of olein, along with the MT Sappire bound for Cirebon with 1,600 tonnes of olein. The MT Pangeran left for Semarang on Wednesday with 1,500 tonnes of olein.
